detail: Sally Leibholz has no death date and no death place in this archive — the family record leaves both blank. He was born at Hammerstein in 1847, living at Hammerstein when he married in November 1874, and living at SCHUBIN by August 1884 when he registered his son Jacob's birth in person. So Schubin is where to look first, and the Szubin registers are now free online.

Szubin has THREE registry offices, not one, and all three are digitised: USC SZUBIN MIASTO (team 6/1792, the town — this family's office, and the one that holds both the 1874 marriage and the 1884 birth), USC SZUBIN WIEŚ I (6/1795) and USC SZUBIN WIEŚ II (6/1796). Filtering the portal to town Szubin and category AKTA ZGONÓW returns **190 UNITS ACROSS 20 TEAMS**.

finding: *** WITHDRAWN 27 SEPTEMBER 2026 — THE INDEX EXISTS AND BYDGOSZCZ HAS SENT IT. ***
detail: The row below concluded that Szubin deaths have no name index and must be paged. IT WAS WRONG, and the way it was wrong is worth more than the row. The reasoning was sound: SKOROWIDZE ZGONÓW returns zero on the portal while the same facet returns 190 units for AKTA ZGONÓW, so the zero is not a broken filter. BUT THAT IS A FACT ABOUT genealogiawarchiwach.pl AND THIS ARCHIVE TURNED IT INTO A FACT ABOUT THE HOLDINGS OF AN ARCHIVE. A CATALOGUE IS NOT AN ARCHIVE. USC SZUBIN MIASTO SYGN. 246 IS AN "ALPHABETISCHES VERZEICHNIS ZU DEM STERBE-REGISTER ÜBER STANDES-AMT SCHUBIN VON 1894 BIS 1908", 103 scans, and it is simply not online. Bydgoszcz sent it on 25 September 2026 under case IU.631.434.2026 in answer to a letter that did not even ask for it. See szubin-sterbe-index-1894-1908.tsv, where the L slot is read out and Leibholz is not in it.

finding: the row as it stood, kept because the mistake is the lesson
detail: *** AND THERE IS NO ALPHABETICAL DEATH INDEX ***
column3: The portal carries SKOROWIDZE — alphabetical name indexes — for Szubin, and they exist for BIRTHS (e.g. 6/1792/0/2.4/336) and for MARRIAGES (6/1792/0/2.4/337). Filtering to SKOROWIDZE ZGONÓW returns **ZERO**. THE CONTROL IS THAT THE SAME FACET WORKS: the identical query with AKTA ZGONÓW returns 190. So the zero is a real absence and not a broken filter. DEATHS AT SZUBIN HAVE NO NAME INDEX AND MUST BE PAGED.

finding: *** THE NAME IS INVISIBLE TO THE PORTAL'S SEARCH, AND THE CONTROL IS SHARP ***
detail: The volunteer person index holds 228,278 people. A search for LEIBHOLZ returns **EXACTLY ONE SCAN** in the entire corpus — the 1874 marriage. A search for SCHMUL, the bride's family, returns **119 SCANS FROM 34 TEAMS ACROSS 104 UNITS**. The index is rich for her name and blind to his. SO A LEIBHOLZ DEATH AT SZUBIN, IF ONE EXISTS, CANNOT BE FOUND BY SEARCHING — it would have to be read off the page.

finding: why that makes this a sweep and not a lookup
detail: THERE IS NO DEATH YEAR TO AIM AT. Sally was alive in August 1884 and could have died at any point afterwards; a man born in 1847 might plausibly die anywhere from the 1880s to the 1920s. With no index, no year and 190 candidate units, this is an open-ended read, not a check.

finding: *** AND SCHUBIN MAY WELL BE THE WRONG TOWN ***
detail: THIS FAMILY MOVED AGAIN. Kurt Luwinski was born in BERLIN in 1912; the Luwinski household is at Chodowieckistraße in 1913; Jacob married Auguste Luwinski in BERLIN in January 1924. If Sally went with his sons to Berlin — and a widowed or elderly father usually does — HE DIED IN BERLIN AND NOT AT SZUBIN AT ALL, and the instrument for that is the Landesarchiv Berlin Namensverzeichnisse this archive already knows how to read. Paging 190 Szubin units before testing that is the expensive way round.

finding: # ---------------- ONE LEAD WORTH MORE THAN THE SEARCH THAT FOUND IT ----------------
*** ONE HUNDRED AND NINETEEN SCHMUL SCANS ARE INDEXED AND NOBODY HAS LOOKED AT THEM ***
detail: FRIEDERICA SCHMUL was born at Schubin and lived at Schubin, and her family name is indexed 119 times across 104 units of this portal — births, marriages and deaths, searchable by name, free. HER PARENTS ARE NAMED IN THE 1874 MARRIAGE ENTRY and this archive has not yet read that half of the page. The Schmul side is the best-documented and least-examined line in the whole family, and it is open to a name search in a way the Leibholz side is not.

finding: # ---------------- 27 SEPTEMBER: ONE HOPE TESTED AND NOT CONFIRMED ----------------
*** THE HOPE WAS THAT THE INDEX IS BOUND INSIDE THE BOOK, WHICH WOULD HAVE MADE THIS CHEAP ***
detail: This row's negative is about SEPARATE skorowidz UNITS, and it is sound: Skorowidze zgonów returns zero against a working control. BUT PRUSSIAN ANNUAL VOLUMES ORDINARILY BIND A NAMENSVERZEICHNIS AT THE BACK OF THE BOOK ITSELF, uncatalogued — which is exactly how this archive reads Berlin. If Szubin's death volumes do that, the sweep is not 190 units of paging but 190 LAST PAGES, and the L slot on each.

finding: *** TESTED, AND THE ONE VOLUME THIS ARCHIVE CAN ALREADY OPEN DOES NOT HAVE ONE ***
detail: Unit 6/1792/0/2.2/141 — the 1874 marriage book — HAS TWELVE SCANS, 0 to 11. Scan 11, the last, was opened at the image: IT IS A BLANK UNUSED PRINTED FORM. No index, no certification page, nothing.

finding: and the test is weak and is recorded as weak
detail: THIS IS THE WORST POSSIBLE VOLUME TO TEST THE HYPOTHESIS ON. Civil registration began on 1 October 1874, so this book covers THREE MONTHS AND NINE MARRIAGES — a stub, and the volume least likely in the whole series to need or carry an alphabetical index. A FULL ANNUAL DEATH VOLUME of a hundred and fifty entries is a different object. THE HYPOTHESIS IS NOT SUPPORTED AND IT IS NOT REFUTED, and the next test is the last scans of one full annual death volume of USC Szubin Miasto.

finding: what stopped that test, stated so nobody repeats the hour
detail: THE PORTAL WILL NOT OPEN A UNIT BY ITS SIGNATURE. There is no unit URL: query.type=UNITS is not a valid value and is silently ignored, a scan's modal id RESOLVES ONLY INSIDE THE CURRENT SEARCH RESULT SET so the neighbouring id cannot be guessed, and the Vaadin search box could not be re-driven while a modal was open. THE ONE ROUTE THAT WORKS, and it is worth writing down: open any scan's modal, click VIEW THE DOCUMENT to expose the unit's own scan list, click Show on the scan wanted, and HARVEST THE NEW LORIS ID FROM THE NETWORK LOG. That reaches any scan of a unit you are already inside; it does not reach a unit you are not.

www.genealogiawarchiwach.pl, searched 22 September 2026: town Szubin with category Akta zgonów (190 units), the same with Skorowidze zgonów (zero), and free-text LEIBHOLZ (1 scan) against SCHMUL (119 scans) as the control pair. Nothing downloaded, nothing purchased, no account created.
